title: Recovery of Planted Subgraphs
summary: Understanding the fundamental limits of recovering planted subgraphs in random graphs is a central challenge in high-dimensional statistics and theoretical computer science. While existing work has largely focused on special subgraph families such as cliques, bicliques, or dense blocks, the exact recovery of a general planted subgraph in Erdős--Rényi random graphs remains poorly understood.
